heading: Real jobs. Real photos. Sent before I leave.
subtext: A few recent jobs across Cedar Mill, Bethany, and NW Portland — open subfloor with new PEX home runs, copper-to-PEX repipes, tankless installs, and the occasional drain cleanout that turned into a sewer scope. Tap any photo for a closer look.
